text:
Anya: Quick postmortem draft from the euw2 near-OOM yesterday — putting notes here for ops + finance. TL;DR: autoscaler hysteresis + network egress bottleneck caused pod pileup and GPU memory pressure.

Max: Can you drop the util graphs? want to see GPU mem and queue lengths.

Miguel: Pasting the important bits from the metric dashboard: 
```
pod_gpu_mem_pct: 0.78 -> 0.95 in 9m
pod_pending_count: 2 -> 28 in 7m
autoscaler_replicas: 12 -> 12 (no scale up)
network_transmit_drop: spike at 10:13 UTC
```

SRE Oncall: The autoscaler didn't scale because CPU sig was under threshold, GPU mem not used for scaling. We hit a feedback where pods were stuck in 'ContainerCreating' waiting on network mount and that kept more jobs queuing.

Anya: Yep — the core issue: our current HPA for model-serving is CPU-based. When GPU memory pressure rises quickly (long sequences), CPU stays low and HPA doesn't react. Meanwhile kube-proxy/netplugin hits transient errors causing mounts/sidecars to stall.

Ops Bot: Deploy record: 2026-02-14T10:00:12Z -> rolling update of model v3.4.1 -> 10:05:33Z completed. No infra changes in that window.

Max: How much extra headroom would have prevented this?

Miguel: Rough calc — if we kept 20% reserved GPU headroom (by pre-warming instances) we would have absorbed the burst. That equates to ~120 GPU hours extra over the 6h incident window.

Finance: 120 GPU hours estimate -> ~ $3.6k at current committed pricing (rough) or $9k at on-demand. Need confirm with cloud pricing table.

Anya: Action items I'm proposing:
- short term: patch HPA to include a custom GPU memory metric (kube-metric-adapter -> HPA) + reduce HPA cool-down to 30s
- medium: add pre-warm pool in euw2 for promo windows (configurable, default 15% of capacity)
- medium: add liveness for network sidecar failures and fast-restart path (avoid long ContainerCreating waits)
- long term: autoscaler rewrite to use combined signal (GPU mem + queue length + recent scale events)

SRE Oncall: +1 on GPU metric. Note: metric adapter needs RBAC update for metrics.k8s.io. I'll open a patch PR and lab test.

Miguel: Also recommend a small rate-limiter on upstream clients during degraded state so we can shed load gracefully rather than queueing.

Finance: For the pre-warm pool ask — need a cost delta by region. If we keep 15% pre-warm in euw2 for Q3 marketing weeks (estimated 72h/week ramp), that's ~X GPU hours; we need a runbook for enabling/disabling with forecast triggers.

Anya: I'll own the runbook and the PR for HPA change. Miguel can prototype the queue-aware autoscaler policy. SRE Oncall please add RBAC patch. Finance please provide final cost approval threshold.

Max: Two learnings to shout out: 1) Autoscaler inputs must reflect the constrained resource (GPU mem) not just CPU. 2) Network failures amplify capacity issues — add health checks and faster bailout.

SRE Oncall: Noted — I'll add a test in the chaos suite to simulate CNI transient drops and verify restart / pre-warm behavior.

Ops Bot: Follow-up tasks created: GHE-4921 (HPA GPU metric), GHE-4922 (pre-warm pool config), GHE-4923 (network sidecar liveness), GHE-4924 (rate-limiter experiment).

Anya: Thanks all. I'll merge the draft postmortem to the incident doc once the HPA PR is green. Tagging @Finance for cost signoff. :thumbsup:
